# Mermaid patterns (generated by render_page.py)

You normally don't write Mermaid by hand – the renderer builds it from `flow.json`.
This file explains what it produces so you can debug output.

## Node shapes by type (flowchart)
| type | shape | syntax |
|---|---|---|
| entry | stadium | `id(["label"])` |
| logic | rectangle | `id["label"]` |
| data | cylinder | `id[("label")]` |
| external | subroutine | `id[["label"]]` |
| decision | rhombus | `id{"label"}` |
| error | hexagon | `id{{"label"}}` |
| ui | rounded | `id("label")` |
| event | asymmetric | `id>"label"]` |

## Edges
- normal: `a --> b` / `a -->|"label"| b` (edge labels are always quoted, otherwise `()` breaks the parser)
- inferred: `a -.-> b` / `a -.->|"label"| b`
- error: `a ==>|label| b` plus red `linkStyle`
- async: `a -.->|async| b` (dashed)

## Escaping
Labels are wrapped in double quotes; the renderer replaces `"` with `#quot;`
and strips newlines. Avoid `<`, `>` in labels – they are converted to `#lt;` / `#gt;`.

## Sequence diagrams
```
sequenceDiagram
  participant orders_route as POST /orders
  orders_route->>create_ctrl: calls
  create_ctrl-->>orders_route: 201 Created
```
`->>` normal, `-->>` inferred/return, `-x` error, `-)` async.

## Click handlers
Each flowchart node gets `click id call cfvSelect("id")` so clicking a node opens
the matching step card. Requires `securityLevel: 'loose'` (set in the template).

## Size
Beyond ~40 nodes layouts degrade. Split into multiple flows and use `link_to`.
